# `terraform stacks deployment-group show` reference

Use the `terraform stacks deployment-group show` command to show details of a deployment group.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks <global-stacks-flags> deployment-group show <options>
```

## Description

The `terraform stacks deployment-group show` command retrieves relevant information for a given deployment group, including its deployment runs. 

You can identify the target deployment group either by providing a deployment group ID directly, or by specifying the organization name, project name, stack name, and deployment group name. When name-based targeting is used, the deployment group associated with the latest configuration for the specified stack is targeted.

## Options

- `-organization-name`: The name of the organization to target.
    - Required when using name-based targeting.
    - String data type.
    - Overrides the ENV VAR `TF_STACKS_ORGANIZATION_NAME` if provided.
- `-project-name`: The name of the project to target.
    - Required when using name-based targeting.
    - String data type.
    - Overrides the ENV VAR `TF_STACKS_PROJECT_NAME` if provided.
- `-stack-name`: The name of the stack to target.
    - Required when using name-based targeting.
    - String data type.
    - Overrides the ENV VAR `TF_STACKS_STACK_NAME` if provided.
- `-deployment-group-name`: The name of the deployment group to show within the latest configuration of the specified stack.
    - Required when using name-based targeting; requires `-organization-name`, `-project-name`, and `-stack-name`.
    - String data type.
- `-deployment-group-id`: The ID of the deployment group to show.
    - Required when not using name-based targeting.
    - String data type.
    - Has precedence over `-deployment-group-name`.
- `-json`: Output results in JSON format.
    - Optional.
    - Boolean flag.
    - Default is false (human-readable output).

## Examples

The following command shows details of a deployment group using organization, project, stack, and deployment group names:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-group show -organization-name my-org -project-name my-project -stack-name my-stack -deployment-group-name my-deployment-group
```

The following command shows details of a deployment group using the deployment group ID:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-group show -deployment-group-id dg-abc123def456
```

The following command shows details of a deployment group and outputs the result in JSON format:

```shell-session
$ terraform stacks deployment-group show -deployment-group-id dg-abc123def456 -json
```
